remote.current_none: The system is available on the office network only.

remote.mode_tailscale_text: A private network between your devices: only people with the Tailscale app signed in to your account can reach it; no public link.
remote.cf_step1: In Cloudflare Zero Trust: Networks → Tunnels → Create a tunnel (Cloudflared).
remote.cf_step2: Add a Public hostname for the domain you want (e.g. erp.example.com), service HTTP, URL localhost:8000.
remote.cf_step3: Copy the tunnel token from the install step and paste it here.
remote.ts_step1: Create a Tailscale account and install the app on the devices that will open the system.
remote.ts_step2: From Settings → Keys create an Auth key and paste it here (a one-time key is recommended).
remote.secret_note: The token or key is handed to the server helper once and then deleted; it is not stored in the database and never returns to the browser. Finish creating the company and the manager account before opening internet access.
